order_guarantee.guarantee: The L7 count-delta check must FAIL BEFORE any write: a source that suddenly carries half as many streets is a publisher error, not a legal road-network change, and the operator override CENTRELINE_ACCEPT_FEATURE_COUNT_DRIFT=1 ENABLES execution but NEVER suppresses the FAIL row — so the abort must land at the pre_write gate, before the DELETE opens a transaction that would empty the network enrich-centreline reads.

Spec 62 §3.5 makes > 5% unrepairable geometry an ABORT: FAIL the run and return BEFORE entering pipeline.withTransaction, so no transaction state can dangle and the pre-existing toronto_centreline is preserved untouched. This check is scored at when:pre_write for exactly that reason — a FAIL row here with no active override skips the write entirely (no transaction is opened).

order_guarantee.anchor: F-C1 dual-mode (L15 / H-v1.3.2): zero-temp on subsequent run
order_guarantee.guarantee: The F-C1 guard runs in JS BEFORE pipeline.withTransaction begins (Spec 62 §3.7: 'Check happens in JS BEFORE this transaction begins'): on a FIRST run (no prior) with zero carried rows there is nothing to insert, and letting the DELETE open would empty the network for a publisher-side empty archive — so the abort must land before the transaction, with the target untouched.

order_guarantee.anchor: F-C1 dual-mode (L15 / H-v1.3.2): zero-temp on subsequent run
order_guarantee.guarantee: The F-C1 subsequent-run arm (Spec 62 §3.7 / L15) fires BEFORE any write and PRESERVES the target: the table is left exactly as the prior run left it and the run completes WARN — so the gate must refuse the write (on_warn: skip_write) rather than open the DELETE/INSERT transaction on a zero-row temp stage.
